title: Top 5 Laptops of 2025: From Framework to MacBook
subtitle: Whether you are a developer, creator, or gamer, these are the machines to beat
author: TechVanguard
content:
2025 was a landmark year for laptop innovation. We saw the rise of RISC-V prototypes, the maturation of ARM on Windows, and Apple M4 chip shattering efficiency records. Here are our top picks for the best laptops you can buy right now.

1. MacBook Pro 14 (M4 Pro)

The king remains the king. Apple M4 Pro chip offers performance that rivals desktop workstations in a chassis that fits in a small backpack. The battery life is now a staggering 22 hours of video playback. It is the default choice for creatives.

2. Framework Laptop 16

For those who value repairability and customization, the Framework Laptop 16 is a dream come true. With its hot-swappable GPU modules and fully modular input deck, it is the most versatile laptop ever made.

3. Dell XPS 15 (2025 Edition)

Dell has finally refreshed the XPS design, slimming down the bezels even further and introducing a haptic trackpad that spans the entire palm rest. It is the sleekest Windows machine out there, powered by Intel Lunar Lake processors.

4. ASUS ROG Zephyrus G14

The G14 continues to be the best portable gaming laptop. The 2025 model features an OLED Nebula HDR display that is simply breathtaking. Paired with the RTX 4070 Mobile, it crushes AAA games at 1440p.

5. Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 13

The business standard. Ultra-light, ultra-durable, and now with a 5G modem standard. It is the boring choice, but it is the right choice for getting work done anywhere.
